title: Heated reply
description: Repeats contested claims and attributes motives; the receipt says so, and the author can still post it.
post:
ZCG funded ZSA work after coinholders voted 99% against ZSAs. That alone shows they ignore the people paying for them, and anyone still defending ZCG here is either on the payroll or not paying attention.

End ZCG and stop the block reward. A taper is just a slower way of keeping the same broken committee.

title: New proposal
description: A calm reply adding a condition nobody had raised: the check records it as new.
post:
One option I have not seen raised in this thread: keep the taper proposed in #1, but make it conditional on ZCG publishing, every quarter, how many milestones were approved, paid and missed, with the ZEC amounts for each.

That would let the 2028 decision rest on numbers rather than impressions, whichever way it goes. I would support the taper with that condition attached, and I would not support it without one.
